lessons.title: Drop the fraction
lessons.description: Finish both functions. `float_div(a, b)` returns true division with `/` (`float_div(7, 2)` is `3.5`). `integer_div(a, b)` returns floor division with `//` (`integer_div(7, 2)` is `3`). The test checks that `float_div(7, 2)` equals `3.5`; `integer_div(7, 2)` equals `3`.
learning_objectives: Two slashes divide and keep only the whole number.

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 3.1.1. Numbers — Introduction (division operators)

exercises.question: Two slashes divide and keep only the whole number.
hints: A single slash would keep the fraction.
Seven split by two leaves a whole three.
print(7 // 2)
exercises.explanation: Two slashes divide and keep only the whole number.

exercises.question: Which operator keeps only the whole part when seven is divided by two?
hints: A single slash would keep a fraction.
The double slash drops the fraction.

hints: The half loaf does not make another tray.

hints: Start with the print of seven.
Use the double slash before the two.
print(7 // 2)

exercises.question: Fill the operator that keeps the whole part of seven divided by two.
hints: The blank is wider than a single slash.
Two slashes belong in the blank.

exercises.question: The bakery printed a fraction of a tray. Which line divides the wrong way?
hints: The loaf count itself is stored correctly.
The display line uses one slash.
Line 2
exercises.explanation: Line 2 uses single-slash division, so the fraction remains.

lessons.title: Keep the leftover
lessons.description: Finish `get_remainder(a, b)` so it returns the remainder of `a` divided by `b`, using `%`. `get_remainder(10, 3)` is `1`, and `get_remainder(15, 5)` is `0`. The test checks that `get_remainder(10, 3)` equals `1`; `get_remainder(15, 5)` equals `0`.
learning_objectives: The percent sign returns only what is left after division.
lessons.solution_code:
def get_remainder(dividend, divisor):
    return dividend % divisor

exercises.question: The percent sign returns only what is left after division.

exercises.explanation: The percent sign returns only what is left after division.

lessons.title: Count whole bills
lessons.description: Finish `exchange_money`, `get_change`, `get_value_of_bills`, `get_number_of_bills` and 2 more. Calculate currency exchanges using division, modulo, and floor division. The test checks that `exchange_money(127.5, 1.2)` equals `106.25`; `get_change(127.5, 120)` equals `7.5`; `get_value_of_bills(5, 128)` equals `640`.
learning_objectives: Whole bills are the floor of the cash divided by the bill size.

exercises.explanation: Whole bills are the floor of the cash divided by the bill size.

lessons.description: Finish `split_bill`. Calculate total bill per person including tip. The test checks that `split_bill(100, 15, 2)` equals `57.5`.
learning_objectives: Each diner is charged the whole-dollar share from floor division.

lessons.solution_code:
def split_bill(total_bill, tip_percentage, people):
    return total_bill * (1 + tip_percentage / 100) / people
